System.out.println("Sets: " + warmUp + workSets);

quiz.q: Is there a difference between Java 23 and Java 25 in the rules for variables and var?
options: Yes: var is new in Java 25
Yes: Java 25 lets a variable change type
No: the rules are the same; only the compact source file around them is final in 25
quiz.explain: var exists since Java 10. Java 25 only makes the compact source file (void main()) final; in JDK 23 it is a preview.

options: It checks whether two values are equal
It stores the value on the right in the variable on the left
It needs the type in front every time
quiz.explain: = is assignment. Comparing is a different operator (==), coming in a later lesson.

flashcards.front: What two things does a variable declaration contain?
